text: Status: ✅ Implemented. `validateModuleCertification()` gains C12 (product suite contract — strict when declared) and C13 (admin contribution shape — advisory). `ok` now depends only on CertificationBlocker checks; advisory checks inform but never block. The manifest guard runs fleet-level suite checks via `validateModuleSuiteFleetV1()`. `score`/`max` preserve full check counts for CLI/Workbench/superadmin consumers.
